name: Practice: Newport to Bermuda
description: Always open. Enter any time; your boat starts the moment you submit a route and sails the classic 635 nm from Newport across the Gulf Stream to Bermuda through today's real wind and current. Finishers are ranked by elapsed time, so a boat that starts on Tuesday races one that started on Friday. Entries stay open for four weeks, then a fresh edition opens. No real fleet, no organiser: this course is for learning the game, trying routing software, and racing your friends whenever you like. Polar: Class40 (meltemus.com) at 90%; everyone sails the same numbers.
